requirement.text: 角色发布资格：每个可用角色须有完整任务、产物修改和依赖/越权异常的运行证据，包含内核/模板/Skill/模型版本、实际交付及费用；首个角色版至少 12 个合格角色并含开发、设计及指定设计师，设计记录不算运行通过。

scope: Source and existing evidence review for role release qualification only. No paid model requests, browser launch, server writes, test suite rerun or full-product completion claim.

observed_loader_result.operation: Read-only Catalog.load() under native Node/tsx in platform cwd
observed_loader_result.qualification_count_scope: Static installed catalogue declarations, not a claim that no real role task has ever succeeded.

implemented.item: Nineteen distinct specialist presets exist, including software development, designer, marketing and workflow roles. Presets contain input contracts, workflows, deliverables, exact skill bindings and model/tool bindings.

Skills are real packaged SKILL.md files, version/hash checked, bound to tasks, emitted as skills.loaded and supplied to the fixed Codex turn as type=skill input. This is more than a renamed system prompt.

Dependency admission checks current runtime, project write authority, plan, role/skill enablement, installed skill hash/state, required model readiness and implemented native/cloud tool availability. Versions remain pinned.
The UI accurately distinguishes evaluation from dependency readiness. It does not label all ready presets as professionally accepted.

findings.summary: The >=12 preset count is implemented, but >=12 fully qualified professional roles is not demonstrated. Current registry qualifications remain pending/unverified, every role readiness evidence list is empty and case declarations remain not_run.
findings.impact: Cannot promise that all software/design role modules deliver professional quality across normal work, editing and dependency/permission failure cases, or claim the first role release satisfies TC-080.
findings.counterevidence_considered: Actual Designer generation/edit/Web delivery and actual fullstack native/cloud tasks exist in recent acceptance records; they prove selected scenarios and do not establish each of twelve roles normal+revision+failure qualification.
findings.not_claimed: This is not nineteen absent roles, not an unavailable Codex kernel and not zero successful real tasks.

findings.summary: Dependency ready/available and professional qualification are separate, but the reviewed runtime/HTTP paths only return unverified or pending_live_validation; no reviewed source/migration path registers a completed version/input/fee-bound professional role qualification and advances the role to qualified.
findings.impact: Even a role with an isolated successful real task does not acquire a traceable complete professional-release qualification through the current inspected state flow.
findings.scope_limit: No live database/API probe was made; the finding describes the inspected packaged catalogue and qualification-producing code, not arbitrary out-of-band operator database edits.

paths_walked: Catalog.load -> layered release definitions -> role/skill lists -> verifySkill(path containment, content hash)
seedSkillVersions -> packaged definition/hash identity -> per-project provisionRoleSkills -> verified installation/state checks
seedAgentTemplates -> immutable preset version containing skill/model/tool/runtime bindings -> qualification_state unverified
template public projection -> current runtime/implemented tools/required model capability -> available flag

assessTemplate -> projectAccess -> runtime version/state -> ensureEnabled -> plan -> currentCapabilities -> cloud/native tools -> package installation/hash -> ready or missing -> qualification_state unverified
Worker execute -> fixed role -> boundSkills -> skills.loaded -> current project/input/content/capability authority -> runtime.start -> exact SKILL.md -> typed skill input to Codex turn

searches.pattern: REQ-080|TC-080|角色发布资格|至少.*12 in requirements/traceability/acceptance
searches.result: Authoritative requirement at SRS line202; traceability maps TC-080; older acceptance explicitly does not complete per-role live qualification. Old wording alone was not used as current code evidence.

Current source qualification_state only unverified in template seed/preflight; Catalog public hardcodes pending_live_validation. Catalogue and layered releases contain empty readiness_evidence. No professional-role qualified state transition found in inspected source/migrations.
Found and traced real version/hash Skill loading and Codex typed-input chain; absence of role implementation is refuted.
Tests explicitly expect ready + unverified, preserve case execution_status and do not widen professional role qualification. Test contents reviewed, suites not rerun.

searches.pattern: role_key|designer|fullstack in latest actual validation scripts and 188-192 reports
searches.result: Recent actual fullstack cloud task uses role_key fullstack; stage189 real Web Designer generation/delivery/edit and measured cost are recorded. No complete per-role >=12 qualification ledger located in these selected recent records.

existing_real_evidence.scope: Real Image2 generation and editing HTTP200; Designer Web task 76ee4703-63d0-4524-8269-ab55d3192970 completed generation, file delivery, download/hash and company fee HK$0.039961. Does not close all Designer professional change/brand/permission cases or twelve roles.
Real native Desktop and Linux cloud program/browser/download workflows passed in their recorded scope. Not a twelve-role professional acceptance run.

not_verified_this_review: No fresh live role API/database state queried.
No role-by-role paid normal/revision/permission-failure tasks executed.
No customer/expert assessment of software quality, brand fidelity, typography, illustrations, editable projects, video or campaign outcomes.
No claim that every possible acceptance artifact in historical blob archives was re-audited; inspected recent records and current state cannot substantiate >=12 complete qualifications.
open_questions: Which twelve role versions are the intended first formally accepted role release?
Who signs professional output quality, what representative business briefs and edit/failure cases are required, and where is the immutable version/input/actual-cost evidence registered?
recommended_followup: Keep the functioning nineteen presets available with accurate evaluation labels. Select at least twelve, execute exact-version normal/revision/permission-dependency cases using real configured company services and explicit budgets, record files/skills/model/input/cost identities, and only mark each role qualified after that evidence is complete.
